verdict.rationale: Exa's docs describe a dedicated Contents API that returns clean page content from URLs, including JavaScript-rendered pages, PDFs and complex layouts. The same contents features are available inline in Search, so a single request can return 'clean, relevant page content', free for up to 10 results. The MCP server also exposes page fetching. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full-text vs. markdown output format or parameter (the excerpt-focused docs leave the full-text mode implied), independent hands-on corroboration of full-page retrieval quality.
